```xml
<robot name="cabinet_sliding_doors">
  <!-- Dimensions (meters) -->
  <!-- Cabinet outer box: width 1.75 (X), height 1.05 (Z), depth 0.38 (Y from front -Y to back +Y). -->
  <!-- Origin on floor at middle of object: (0,0,0). Front faces -Y. -->

  <!-- Assumed construction thicknesses -->
  <!-- Back/side panels: 0.018 m -->
  <!-- Top/bottom panels: 0.018 m -->
  <!-- Door thickness: 0.018 m -->
  <!-- Floor/base thickness: 0.018 m -->
  <!-- Tracks thickness: 0.005 m -->

  <link name="world"/>

  <!-- Cabinet base -->
  <link name="base_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Approx mass: 1.75*0.38*0.018*800 ~= 10.44 kg -->
      <mass value="10.44"/>
      <!-- Box inertia about its center -->
      <inertia ixx="0.316" iyy="0.873" izz="1.261" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.38 0.018"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.009" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.38 0.018"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Cabinet back panel -->
  <link name="back_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Mass: width*height*thickness*800 ~= 1.75*1.05*0.018*800 = 26.46 kg -->
      <mass value="26.46"/>
      <!-- Back panel is a box: size (1.75, 0.018, 1.05) -->
      <!-- Half extents: hx=0.875, hy=0.009, hz=0.525 -->
      <!-- Ixx = (1/12)m*(hy^2+hz^2) -->
      <!-- Iyy = (1/12)m*(hx^2+hz^2) -->
      <!-- Izz = (1/12)m*(hx^2+hy^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="7.099" iyy="41.451" izz="10.710" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.018 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.018 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Cabinet left side panel -->
  <link name="left_side_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.875 -0.001 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Mass: depth*height*thickness*800 ~ 0.38*1.05*0.018*800 = 5.75 kg -->
      <mass value="5.75"/>
      <!-- Side panel box: size (0.018, 0.38, 1.05) -->
      <!-- Half extents: hx=0.009, hy=0.19, hz=0.525 -->
      <inertia ixx="1.704" iyy="0.966" izz="0.986" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.875 0 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.018 0.38 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.875 0 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.018 0.38 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Cabinet right side panel -->
  <link name="right_side_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="-0.875 -0.001 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.75"/>
      <inertia ixx="1.704" iyy="0.966" izz="0.986" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.875 0 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.018 0.38 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.875 0 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.018 0.38 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Cabinet top panel -->
  <link name="top_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 1.041" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Mass: width*depth*thickness*800 ~= 1.75*0.38*0.018*800 = 10.44 kg -->
      <mass value="10.44"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.316" iyy="0.873" izz="1.261" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 1.041" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.38 0.018"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 1.041" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.75 0.38 0.018"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left track (front track) -->
  <link name="left_track">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 0.105" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Track length ~ 1.75/2 = 0.875, width(depth) ~ 0.03, thickness 0.005 -->
      <!-- Use box size: (0.875, 0.03, 0.005), mass ~ 0.875*0.03*0.005*7800 ~= 1.026 kg -->
      <mass value="1.03"/>
      <!-- Half extents: hx=0.4375, hy=0.015, hz=0.0025 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.00092" iyy="0.0660" izz="0.0666" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.21875 -0.19 0.105" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.03 0.005"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="steel"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.21875 -0.19 0.105" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.03 0.005"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right track (front track) -->
  <link name="right_track">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.19 0.105" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="1.03"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.00092" iyy="0.0660" izz="0.0666" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.21875 -0.19 0.105" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.03 0.005"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="steel"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.21875 -0.19 0.105" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.03 0.005"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Sliding left door (occupies left half width initially) -->
  <link name="left_door">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.009 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Door is box: width 0.875, depth 0.018 (front to back), height 1.05 -->
      <!-- Mass ~ 0.875*0.018*1.05*600 ~= 9.96 kg -->
      <mass value="9.96"/>
      <!-- Half extents: hx=0.4375, hy=0.009, hz=0.525 -->
      <inertia ixx="1.461" iyy="2.720" izz="1.612" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <!-- Initial position: left half means x = +0.21875, center depth slightly forward at y = -0.19+0.009 -->
      <origin xyz="0.21875 -0.181 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.018 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_doors"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.21875 -0.181 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.018 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Sliding right door (occupies right half width initially) -->
  <link name="right_door">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.009 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="9.96"/>
      <inertia ixx="1.461" iyy="2.720" izz="1.612" unit="kg*m^2"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.21875 -0.181 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.018 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_doors"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.21875 -0.181 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.875 0.018 1.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Materials -->
  <material name="oak">
    <color rgba="0.77 0.56 0.39 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_doors">
    <color rgba="0.72 0.49 0.32 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="steel">
    <color rgba="0.6 0.6 0.65 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- Fixed joints to assemble cabinet -->
  <joint name="base_to_world" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="base_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="back_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="back_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="left_side_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="left_side_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="right_side_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="right_side_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="top_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="top_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Fixed joints for tracks -->
  <joint name="left_track_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="left_track"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="right_track_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="right_track"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Sliding joints (doors move sideways along X). -->
  <!-- Left door prismatic along +X. -->
  <joint name="left_door_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="left_door"/>
    <!-- Put joint frame at initial door center position, so joint origin is at base reference -->
    <origin xyz="0.21875 -0.181 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.21875" upper="0.21875" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="5" friction="0.5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Right door prismatic along -X (still axis X, but we set limits such that it moves opposite). -->
  <joint name="right_door_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_panel"/>
    <child link="right_door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.21875 -0.181 0.525" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <!-- When left door moves +X by up to +0.21875, right door should move -X by up to -0.21875.
         With same axis, right door joint moves from initial at x=-0.21875 to x=+0.0? Here limit ranges allow overlap. -->
    <limit lower="-0.21875" upper="0.21875" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="5" friction="0.5"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
```
